content.comment_body: When I try to connect to the [product_name]24 RC using [product_name] programming software [version_no], I get a "Transmission error /dev/tty.SLAB-USBto UARD is not available." message. My setup details: Mac OSX [version_no], keyspan serial assistant [version_no] installed, /var/loc map is accessible, /var/spool/uucp is empty. The USB driver cardinal-osx-[version_no]-release is installed and the computer was restarted afterward. The [product_name] is connected and operational. Cable [article_no] is in use.

The [product_name] programming software [version_no] is compatible with Mac OS-X [version_no] (see the included documentation). Since you have OS-X [version_no], your operating system is not supported.
Hello, You should upgrade the programming software to [version_no]; it's available here: [document], upgrades/updates, and drivers. Regards,

Hello [user_name], It is likely that the communication library file "librxtxSerial.jnilib" is not compatible with your OSX version or you might be running a 64bit OSX. I have attached the USB driver and three different librxtxSerial.jnilib files (for OSX <=[version_no], for OSX >=[version_no], and for 64bit OSX [version_no]). First, install the USB driver. If it doesn't work, try replacing the librxtxSerial.jnilib file in your [product_name] installation directory or in /Library/Java/Extensions/. Hope this helps!
Hi, The download does not include the driver for 64bit systems. Could it be uploaded again? Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing difficulties connecting the [product_name]24 RC over USB to MacOS using [product_name] programming software [version_no], mainly due to version incompatibility and absence of drivers for 64-bit systems. The inability to establish communication stems from outdated or missing software and driver support for newer operating systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable USB connectivity between [product_name]24 RC and their Mac, with compatible drivers and libraries for their OS version.
